rubric.role_summary: Senior B2B SaaS growth marketing role owning integrated campaign strategy, execution, measurement, and budget for a segment, with a focus on demand generation and pipeline.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior B2B SaaS growth marketing role owning integrated campaign strategy, execution, measurement, and budget for a segment, with a focus on demand generation and pipeline.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or growth marketing.
- Experience owning integrated marketing campaigns.
- Hands-on experience with marketing automation (HubSpot) and Salesforce.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- 8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or growth marketing, including building programs rather than only shipping campaigns.
- Track record owning integrated campaigns end-to-end, from strategy and brief through results and budget accountability.
- Experience setting campaign measurement standards.
- Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, SDR, creative, and Product Marketing.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
